name: Nicholas C. Park
description: Nicholas C. Park: machine learning engineering, reinforcement learning, and experiments in how agents learn and adapt.
about: I build machine learning systems and study how they improve through experience. My background spans quantitative modeling, software engineering, and graduate study at Georgia Tech. I care about the full experimental loop: establishing a baseline, measuring behavior, and using the results to improve the system.

My graduate course projects explored cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning and how training-data selection affects language-model performance. I’m interested in agents that learn from feedback and adapt as conditions change, especially in visual and interactive environments.
